ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 70% high-intensity (white) surface area to 30% low-intensity (black) pixel clusters, creating a high-contrast ratio across the visible ventral field.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-density irregular black mottling and circular pixel blobs concentrated along the trailing edge and distal tips; central medial regions exhibit lower density, discrete circular spotting.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped central depression with an estimated internal vertex angle of 60 degrees; high pixel-depth relative to the maximum lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular peak-and-valley distribution across the entire trailing boundary; extreme serration amplitude observed at the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Linear-to-concave trajectory originating from the median notch, transitioning into a broad convex curve toward the outer lobe terminals.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Significant presence of circular and annular high-contrast pixel rings distributed predominantly on the upper-left lobe and the far-right peripheral edge.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A single, distinct, dark horizontal linear disruption located on the right lobe, approximately 100-150 pixels lateral to the median notch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized yellowish-orange pixel intensity shifts on the medial left lobe surface; irregular trailing edge geometry suggesting historical tissue degradation at the distal points.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly complex, interlocking 'labyrinthine' pigment structures present on the right distal lobe.
